headline: SSH to production app instances is open to the entire internet, not just the on-call rotation

findings.evidence_ref: New ingress rule: port 22, protocol tcp, cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
findings.explanation: The rule opens SSH to any IP address on the internet, not to the on-call rotation as described. This dramatically expands the attack surface of production instances. The implementation must be restricted to known IPs, a VPN CIDR, or the follow-up Session Manager solution before merging.
